blocks.body: # Executive Job Engine: Code-to-Market Review and Go Plan (July 2026)

## Verdict

**No-go for a broad commercial launch. Go for a 24-hour evidence-and-correction sprint, continued Matthew-only use, and sanitized buyer interviews.** A paid three-user concierge beta is conditional on every P0 trust and isolation gate passing. The viable wedge is not generic career AI; it is candidate-controlled source truth, evidence truth, executive pursuit judgment, and immutable approvals.

## Five critical truths

1. The product is materially beyond a prototype, but implementation, deployment, and acceptance evidence currently disagree.
2. Source capture, compensation/relocation reasoning, and the Career Canon are the most promising foundations.
3. Hidden rank weights, client-generated qualification precision, incomplete application retrieval, and ambiguous run receipts directly undermine the trust claim.
4. The current resume system can produce fact-safe work and still correctly conclude that a cold application is a no-go; pursuit channel must therefore precede document generation.
5. Tenant isolation, candidate ownership, export, deletion, and atomic paid workflows are commercial gates, not later enterprise polish.

## P0 launch gates

The highest-priority work is truth and safety work. A code path, button, or passing deterministic contract test does not close a hosted production acceptance failure.

## First 24 hours

Freeze the environment, reconcile acceptance, prove the three core role journeys, attack concurrency and source accounting, repair misleading states, then issue separate decisions for private use, demos, design partners, paid beta, and broad launch.

## Product and market assessment

The visible feature bundle is mostly commoditized. The integrated evidence-grounded workflow may still be distinctive if it becomes easier than a resume-plus-ChatGPT workflow and more trustworthy than automation-first competitors.

## Twelve-month path

Prove trust before onboarding, paid executive value before distribution, and repeatability before scale. If the human work remains high, price and operate it honestly as a tech-enabled service.

## Evidence and limitations

Live behavior was inspected read-only on 2026-07-15. Current deterministic repository checks passed, but this review did not mutate Supabase, run paid generation, send anything, apply to a role, test destructive deletion, or independently close hosted concurrency and multi-tenant acceptance. The competitive landscape is a source-cited 77-product sample, not a census. Accessibility observations are risks requiring testing, not a compliance determination. Commercial thresholds are hypotheses, not forecasts.

top_p0.recommendation: Adopt one canonical application-stage enum and render every loaded record exactly once
top_p0.why_now: Interviewing, follow-up, on-hold, and closed rows can disappear from both current columns
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Rendered plus deliberately archived equals total loaded for every fixture

top_p0.recommendation: Remove the silent eight-row ceiling or expose server pagination and total counts
top_p0.why_now: Current counts can represent only a truncated client window
top_p0.acceptance_gate: UI says loaded X of Y and active stages are complete

top_p0.recommendation: Map legacy statuses explicitly and never show a dropdown value that differs from stored state
top_p0.why_now: Unknown values can visually fall back to Applied
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Every persisted status renders truthfully or as Legacy status - review

top_p0.recommendation: Document the source-of-truth split and prohibit production decisions from stale local copies
top_p0.why_now: Three materially different frontends exist and the stale copy can mislead review
top_p0.acceptance_gate: One architecture map names live repo, proof app, stale portal copy, backend, and authority

top_p0.recommendation: Fix direct Canon route hydration so Resume Lanes and required evidence collections actually load
top_p0.why_now: The route renders Resume Lanes but its view map does not request them
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Direct reload shows the same 3 lanes and evidence counts as System

top_p0.recommendation: Permit Matthew-only use and sanitized buyer interviews; defer external logins
top_p0.why_now: The software is not yet a tenant-ready commercial product
top_p0.acceptance_gate: No third-party PII enters the current production environment

top_p0.recommendation: Make search receipts distinguish queued, running, no-results, partial, failed, stale, and complete
top_p0.why_now: Live runs display in progress with zeros and missing fields are coerced to zero
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Unknown is never displayed as zero and every terminal state has a reason

top_p0.recommendation: Reconcile seen, new, changed, unchanged, suppressed, deduped, deferred, and failed counts under one accounting identity
top_p0.why_now: Receipt UI exists but production evidence has not accepted its ledger
top_p0.acceptance_gate: The documented equation reconciles for a controlled production run

top_p0.recommendation: Prove restore from All roles survives reload and future source refresh
top_p0.why_now: Restore code exists while the newest acceptance audit still marks it failed
top_p0.acceptance_gate: A suppressed identity is restored, persists, and refreshes only on material source change

top_p0.recommendation: Do not accept external candidate data until tenant isolation, candidate ownership, deletion, and export are proven
top_p0.why_now: The product is Matthew-specific and current auth proves one allowed user, not multi-tenant safety
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Real cross-user denial, row isolation, full export, deletion, and audit-log tests pass

top_p0.recommendation: Split artifact integrity from pursuit strategy, qualification readiness, and operational readiness
top_p0.why_now: An approved ATS artifact can still be a cold-application no-go
top_p0.acceptance_gate: The UI can say artifact safe while pursuit recommendation is warm intro or do not apply

top_p0.recommendation: Require deterministic per-factual-clause mapping to approved Canon evidence before employer-use approval
top_p0.why_now: Matched_fact_ids greater than zero does not prove complete coverage
top_p0.acceptance_gate: One hundred percent of factual clauses map to admissible facts; unsupported-claim escapes equal zero

top_p0.recommendation: Report packet readiness as exact usable versus blocked document counts
top_p0.why_now: One role can show a ready kit when 8 of 9 outputs lack per-document evidence
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Banner states 1 of 9 usable and names blockers by document

top_p0.recommendation: Choose pursuit channel before generating documents
top_p0.why_now: Nine default outputs create cost, review burden, and irrelevant work
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Cold ATS, warm intro, recruiter conversation, executive-network outreach, search-firm profile, interview prep, evidence-first, or pass is selected first

top_p0.recommendation: Rename Best to Curated review order and expose the three dominant ranking factors
top_p0.why_now: Hidden review-tier weights dwarf visible opportunity scores
top_p0.acceptance_gate: A user can explain why rank 1 sits above rank 2 without reading code

top_p0.recommendation: Stop synthesizing a qualification score in the browser when no persisted scored artifact exists
top_p0.why_now: The fallback gives 55 percent credit to needs_review and creates false precision
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Incomplete evidence displays Not scored or a confidence band, never an invented exact score

top_p0.recommendation: Separate opportunity attractiveness, qualification evidence, source confidence, pursuit recommendation, compensation confidence, and relocation friction
top_p0.why_now: Strong Fit can coexist with Qualifications 0 and confuse the decision
top_p0.acceptance_gate: No single label conflates search shape with evidence-backed qualification

top_p0.recommendation: Create one commit/deploy-bound acceptance ledger with implemented, locally tested, deployed, and production-accepted states
top_p0.why_now: The June live matrix, July 14 audit, current working tree, and live UI disagree
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Every critical row names commit, environment, timestamp, test, screenshot, and owner

top_p0.recommendation: Freeze and record current HEAD, dirty diff, deployed asset hash, Edge Function versions, database migrations, and screenshots
top_p0.why_now: Current uncommitted work may be mistaken for deployed proof
top_p0.acceptance_gate: One immutable baseline packet exists before any launch decision

top_p0.recommendation: Treat the 24-hour outcome as go/no-go evidence, not a broad commercial launch
top_p0.why_now: The newest audit still has 4 failed and 15 partial items
top_p0.acceptance_gate: No external candidate data or login is accepted while a P0 is open

top_p0.recommendation: Preserve focus and update only the result region while typing filters
top_p0.why_now: Current input handlers replace the full root DOM on each keystroke
top_p0.acceptance_gate: A multi-word filter can be typed uninterrupted with focus and selection preserved

top_p0.recommendation: Use loading and partial states instead of empty zero states during direct-route hydration
top_p0.why_now: Direct Find roles and Next actions can briefly claim no rows while data is still loading
top_p0.acceptance_gate: No authenticated route renders a false empty state before required data resolves

top_p0.recommendation: Prove atomic server-side step claiming and idempotency under concurrent advance requests
top_p0.why_now: A real run produced duplicate paid Writer calls
top_p0.acceptance_gate: Twenty concurrent or retried calls yield one billable step, one output, and one approval

top_p0.recommendation: Attach every workflow state to one canonical job, posting hash, Canon revision, and run version
top_p0.why_now: Stale or ambiguous runs can be advanced without enough visible context
top_p0.acceptance_gate: All model and approval records resolve to one current evidence snapshot

hour_plan.actions: Record repo HEAD and dirty diff; deployed asset hash; Edge Function versions; database migrations; live counts; screenshots; canonical acceptance source
hour_plan.required_proof: One immutable evidence baseline tied to environment and timestamp
hour_plan.decision: Continue only with explicit Matthew-only or commercial definition of go

hour_plan.actions: Compare June live matrix, July 14 audit, current source, current tests, and hosted behavior; classify every failed and partial item
hour_plan.required_proof: Every item is implemented only, locally proven, deployed, production accepted, or still open
hour_plan.decision: No code-presence claim may close a production failure

hour_plan.actions: Run source-complete high-fit, source-complete moderate-fit, and source-incomplete roles through posting, brief, qualification, material, approval, and export gates
hour_plan.required_proof: Complete states advance; incomplete source remains blocked; all evidence stays role scoped
hour_plan.decision: Stop if any workflow advances across an invalid gate

hour_plan.actions: Issue concurrent and retried advance requests against a controlled no-employer-action workflow
hour_plan.required_proof: Twenty requests produce one billable step, one durable output, one canonical approval, and one cost entry
hour_plan.decision: No-go if any duplicate paid step or output occurs

hour_plan.actions: Run a bounded official-source search; reconcile seen, new, changed, unchanged, suppressed, deduped, deferred, and failed; restore one suppressed fixture and reload
hour_plan.required_proof: Accounting identity reconciles; unknown is not zero; restore persists and future refresh behavior is correct
hour_plan.decision: No-go if run state or counts remain ambiguous

hour_plan.actions: Expose curated rank rationale; remove client fallback scores; separate source state, opportunity, qualification, pursuit, comp, and relocation
hour_plan.required_proof: A test user can explain rank and readiness from the screen alone
hour_plan.decision: No-go if the UI still says best, strong fit, ready, or zero ambiguously

hour_plan.actions: Centralize statuses; ensure every record renders once; add total count and pagination; preserve submitted artifact version
hour_plan.required_proof: All fixtures and cloud rows appear in exactly one truthful stage
hour_plan.decision: No-go if any persisted application can disappear or display the wrong status

hour_plan.actions: Select cold ATS, warm intro, recruiter, executive network, interview, evidence-first, or pass before generation; audit every factual clause
hour_plan.required_proof: Every final clause maps to admissible Canon evidence and artifact integrity is separate from pursuit recommendation
hour_plan.decision: No-go if any unsupported claim can be approved or a cold no-go appears application ready

hour_plan.actions: Run real second-account denial; verify row isolation; candidate export and deletion; provider and retention registry; least-privilege support access
hour_plan.required_proof: No cross-user access; complete portable export; verifiable deletion; audit log
hour_plan.decision: No third-party data if any privacy proof is missing

hour_plan.actions: Publish one acceptance report with open gates, evidence links, rollback, owners, and next dates
hour_plan.required_proof: Written state-specific decision for Matthew-only use, demos, external design partners, paid beta, and broad launch
hour_plan.decision: Default is no-go for external login until every P0 is passed

capability_assessment.current_state: 604 roles were loaded in the inspected live snapshot; breadth is already ample, but recent runs and inventory counts disagree
capability_assessment.competitive_context: LinkedIn, Indeed, Jobright, Simplify, Teal, and aggregators exceed or match breadth and distribution
capability_assessment.verdict: Do not compete on inventory volume
capability_assessment.next_move: Optimize for 3-5 decision-worthy roles per week and make run accounting truthful

capability_assessment.current_state: Official/ATS links, verification, suppression, identities, and safe-apply artifacts are substantive; source labels still collapse different evidence states
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Most trackers capture a URL, while job agents own breadth; fewer publicly expose immutable source provenance
capability_assessment.verdict: Promising wedge, not yet accepted end to end
capability_assessment.next_move: Adopt one source-state ladder and one versioned search receipt

capability_assessment.current_state: 405 roles showed full postings, and materials block incomplete sources; code uses multiple thresholds for what full means
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Competitors often store descriptions, but public evidence of immutable full-posting snapshots and change lineage is limited
capability_assessment.verdict: Differentiated only if definitions and change invalidation are exact
capability_assessment.next_move: Define one material-ready contract with timestamp, hash, parsed sections, freshness, and semantic diff

capability_assessment.current_state: Aliases, conflict handling, suppression, duplicate, unchanged, and changed states show strong intent
capability_assessment.competitive_context: General trackers and job boards have large identity graphs but rarely make candidate-visible provenance central
capability_assessment.verdict: Technically strong but operational proof is incomplete
capability_assessment.next_move: Prove reconciliation and restore across reload and future refresh

capability_assessment.current_state: Compensation, location, scope, company, and upside are separated from qualification
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Jobright, LinkedIn, Levels.fyi, executive networks, and human advisors already provide pieces of opportunity intelligence
capability_assessment.verdict: Useful but labels currently overstate precision
capability_assessment.next_move: Expose score version, confidence, factors, and separate pursuit recommendation

capability_assessment.current_state: Requirement-level evidence exists, but the browser can synthesize exact fallback values and reuse one score across dimensions
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Teal, Jobscan, Huntr, Careerflow, and many resume tools provide matching and gaps
capability_assessment.verdict: Currently less trustworthy than the strongest commodity match tools
capability_assessment.next_move: Remove browser fallback; show not scored and requirement-level evidence confidence

capability_assessment.current_state: Base versus package/OTE, equity, geography, missing pay, and relocation tradeoffs are modeled explicitly
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Market products offer salary filters and benchmarks; few candidate tools publicly combine compensation confidence and relocation decision logic
capability_assessment.verdict: Real executive differentiation if calibrated and explainable
capability_assessment.next_move: Show source/confidence/range logic and validate decisions with paid users

capability_assessment.current_state: 40 facts and three lanes feed scoring and writing, but the UI is a flat list and direct-route hydration omits lanes
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Generic AI projects, Notion, and resume master profiles can approximate a knowledge base; few career products publicly govern claim variants and uses
capability_assessment.verdict: Potential core moat, current UX does not earn it
capability_assessment.next_move: Use explicit approved allowlist, fix hydration, and ship evidence cards with source excerpts and usage lineage

capability_assessment.current_state: Evidence-safe generation and parser review exist; the audited OpenAI v6 resume was factual but scored 73/100 and was a cold-apply no-go
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Jobscan, Rezi, Teal, Resume Worded, Careerflow, and many low-cost tools are mature here
capability_assessment.verdict: Commoditized unless claim lineage and channel strategy are exceptional
capability_assessment.next_move: Separate factual integrity from role coverage and cold-application readiness

capability_assessment.current_state: Distinct resume concepts exist, but current proof does not show consistent executive-level narrative superiority
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Korn Ferry, outplacement firms, executive coaches, and specialist writers can exceed generic AI editorial judgment
capability_assessment.verdict: Unproven commercial quality
capability_assessment.next_move: Run blinded advisor comparisons by channel and role family

capability_assessment.current_state: The product can recommend next actions, but writing still precedes an explicit channel decision in the default mental model
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Human coaches and executive networks are stronger at deciding recruiter, warm intro, cold ATS, search firm, or pass
capability_assessment.verdict: Missing orchestration layer
capability_assessment.next_move: Choose pursuit channel before generation and treat do-not-cold-apply as a successful outcome

capability_assessment.current_state: Role-scoped outreach assets exist and no automatic send is allowed
capability_assessment.competitive_context: LinkedIn, Teal, Simplify, WonsultingAI, CRM products, and coaches cover outreach well
capability_assessment.verdict: Table stakes; trust boundary is more valuable than output volume
capability_assessment.next_move: Generate only channel-relevant outreach and preserve manual employer action

capability_assessment.current_state: Revisions and reusable guidance exist, but rule promotion needs scope, provenance, conflict handling, and review dates
capability_assessment.competitive_context: General AI projects and writing products can retain preferences cheaply
capability_assessment.verdict: Not a moat without governed learning
capability_assessment.next_move: Make every promoted rule explicit, scoped, reversible, and attributable

capability_assessment.current_state: Versions exist, but comparison is full side-by-side text and numbering/persistence are client-calculated
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Teal, Huntr, document tools, and general versioning products cover basic history
capability_assessment.verdict: Below the standard needed for high-stakes approvals
capability_assessment.next_move: Use server-allocated immutable versions and semantic claim/evidence diffs

capability_assessment.current_state: Manual approvals and approved exports exist; approvals do not yet prove an exact signed source/Canon/content snapshot
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Jobscan and several automation tools now provide approval-first steps
capability_assessment.verdict: Strong brand boundary, incomplete technical guarantee
capability_assessment.next_move: Sign posting, brief, Canon, content, model, and review hashes and invalidate stale approvals

capability_assessment.current_state: One honest live record exists, but only eight rows load and legitimate statuses can disappear from both columns
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Teal, Huntr, Simplify, Careerflow, and general CRMs are substantially more mature
capability_assessment.verdict: P0 product defect, not differentiation
capability_assessment.next_move: Centralize stages, paginate with totals, render every record exactly once, and add a pursuit timeline

capability_assessment.current_state: Preparation assets exist but the current system is not a specialist interview practice platform
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Final Round AI, Big Interview, Huru, interviewing.io, Exponent, and coaches exceed it in practice depth
capability_assessment.verdict: Partial adjacency
capability_assessment.next_move: Focus on evidence-grounded executive stories and decision questions, not generic mock-interview breadth

capability_assessment.current_state: Role briefs, economics, gaps, next actions, and controlled materials form a coherent decision system; hidden rank weights and conflicting labels weaken it
capability_assessment.competitive_context: No public reviewed product evidenced the identical integrated stack, but human advisors and DIY AI stacks can substitute
capability_assessment.verdict: Best commercial wedge if trust semantics become exceptional
capability_assessment.next_move: Rename Best to Curated review order and make every recommendation explainable

capability_assessment.current_state: Deterministic checks pass, but the July audit records duplicate paid Writer calls and no accepted end-to-end role kit
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Enterprise workflow products provide stronger idempotency, tenancy, and audit guarantees
capability_assessment.verdict: Commercial blocker
capability_assessment.next_move: Implement atomic server-side claims, bounded retries, unique outputs/approvals, and concurrency acceptance tests

capability_assessment.current_state: Single-user access and no automatic employer actions are good; tenant isolation, export, deletion, and provider governance are not commercially proven
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Executive outplacement and enterprise vendors sell trust, contracts, controls, and support
capability_assessment.verdict: No-go for external candidate data
capability_assessment.next_move: Prove real second-account denial, row isolation, portable export, deletion, retention, and provider registry

capability_assessment.current_state: The integrated product is credible as founder-led decision infrastructure, not yet as self-serve SaaS
capability_assessment.competitive_context: Commodity career AI anchors price low; coaches and outplacement anchor high-touch value high
capability_assessment.verdict: Start as a tightly bounded tech-enabled service
capability_assessment.next_move: After P0 gates, test one 12-week concierge Search Pass with at most five users and record all human/model cost

roadmap.objective: Issue a defensible state-specific go/no-go decision
roadmap.deliverables: Truth freeze; acceptance reconciliation; three controlled role journeys; concurrency proof; search accounting and restore; truthful rank and score states; complete applications; channel-first material audit; privacy boundary review
roadmap.exit_gates: Every tested P0 has environment-bound evidence; no code-presence claim closes a production failure; default no external login while any P0 is open
roadmap.commercial_action: Continue Matthew-only use and sanitized interviews; do not onboard external candidate data

roadmap.deliverables: Generated acceptance ledger; atomic workflow steps; one source-state ladder; change invalidation; score provenance; complete application stages; pursuit-channel gate; per-clause evidence release; Canon allowlist/evidence-card slice; tenant design and isolation tests
roadmap.exit_gates: Zero open P0; zero duplicate billable steps; zero unsupported claims in 10 independent audits; cross-user isolation passes; no false empty/zero critical state
roadmap.commercial_action: Prepare a maximum five-user concierge cohort only after all gates pass

roadmap.deliverables: 5-10 founder-led paid users; guided Canon import; weekly source-backed briefs; channel-specific artifacts; blinded advisor review; complete human/model cost log; baseline comparison
roadmap.exit_gates: 70% of qualified briefs yield a decision without outside reconciliation; 80% first-pass material audit; zero factual escape; users can explain rank and channel
roadmap.commercial_action: Run one 12-week Search Pass offer and avoid simultaneous pricing sprawl

roadmap.deliverables: 60 qualified demos; standardized onboarding; unit economics; outcome/channel instrumentation; calibration baseline; missed-winner audits
roadmap.exit_gates: 15 paid customers from 60 qualified demos; 60% weekly active use; 70% gross margin including human time; no high-severity privacy defect
roadmap.commercial_action: Choose software-led pass, explicitly priced service, narrower wedge, or stop

roadmap.deliverables: Automate costly Canon and reconciliation work; modularize high-risk domains; calibrate decisions; add user-authorized relationship/private-mandate capture; publish trust controls
roadmap.exit_gates: 50% lower material rework; stable source adapters; measurable decision-time advantage; no claim or isolation regression
roadmap.commercial_action: Expand only the winning ICP/channel combination

roadmap.deliverables: Three paid coach or boutique outplacement pilots; candidate-controlled sharing/revocation; sponsor-safe aggregates; governed playbooks
roadmap.exit_gates: 30% more client capacity or 40% less review time; candidate confidentiality preserved
roadmap.commercial_action: Continue B2B2C only if candidate control remains primary

roadmap.deliverables: Security hardening; role-based administration; automated retention/deletion; source SLOs; continuity offer; commercial playbook
roadmap.exit_gates: 70% gross margin; 30% completion-to-renewal or qualified referral; no unresolved high-severity authorization/privacy issue
roadmap.commercial_action: Scale selectively; do not add employer-side ranking or automatic employer actions
